verdict.rationale: Omnara's docs explicitly let you "follow an agent's progress live" and send corrections mid-run [omnara-docs-7]. Agents can pause for input or approval [omnara-docs-8], and you can watch and interact through the dashboard or Slack [omnara-gh-3]. Event webhooks [omnara-docs-22] and subagent progress reading [omnara-docs-19] add more ways to observe activity. Community comments praise the remote-monitoring UI, but none specifically corroborate the live status view. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of what current-status states and fields are exposed, and independent hands-on corroboration of the live progress view.
